definitions.gloss: bare skin; skin without makeup or covering
definitions.explanation: Skin in its natural state, without cosmetics, foundation, or clothing covering it. Often used in beauty and skincare contexts.

examples.japanese: {素肌|すはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{素肌|すはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I choose cosmetics that are gentle on bare skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スキンケア→スキンケア：23083_sukinkea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、{素肌|すはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After continuing my daily skincare routine, I became confident in my natural skin.

notes:
Composed of {素|す} (plain, bare, natural) + ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin). Frequently used in beauty advertising and skincare discussions. Emphasizes the natural, unadorned state of the skin. The prefix {素|す} implies "without anything added."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素肌|すはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧: to have beautiful skin
- {素肌|すはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい: gentle on the skin
- {素肌|すはだ}⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧: natural-skin beauty
- {素肌|すはだ}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: bare-skin care
- {素肌|すはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be confident about one's skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: skin — general term
- ⟦すっぴん→すっぴん：09310_suppin⟧: no-makeup face — specifically about not wearing makeup on the face
- {生肌|なまはだ}: raw/bare skin — less common, can imply exposed flesh
- ⟦{地肌|じはだ}→地肌：20380_jihada⟧: scalp; bare ground — used for the scalp or surface texture
